start: HQ open in the browser, signed in, several real gyms exist

steps.action: Open HQ (it opens on All gyms)
user_sees: Heading 'All gyms' with the button 'Make a gym'
Tiles 'Gyms', 'Members', 'Need a look'
Line '<n> gyms. Tap a gym for more.'
must_not: Test and demo gyms counted in the tiles while they are hidden

steps.action: Type a gym code into 'Search' (placeholder 'Gym, code, owner or mobile')
user_sees: Line 'Showing 1 of <n> gyms.'
The one gym row with code, status, members, check-ins and owner
must_not: Rows of other gyms left in the table
The count line still saying the full number

user_sees: That gym's HQ page opens
must_not: The search is lost when coming back with ‹ All gyms

start: All gyms page, some gyms are new or paused, one business has two branches

user_sees: The list scrolls to the table
Line 'Showing <x> of <n> gyms.'
'Show' set to the same filter
must_not: The tile number different from the rows shown

user_sees: Each business with '<n> branches' and members in registers and in the app
Each branch a link to its HQ page
must_not: A branch listed under the wrong business

start: All gyms page while Cloudflare's small database cannot be read, then a search that matches nothing

user_sees: Warning 'Feedback, leads and AI use could not be read right now.'
The gym rows still shown
must_not: AI use shown as 0 as if it were true

user_sees: 'No gym matches.'
Button 'Show all gyms'
must_not: An empty table with no words

user_sees: Every gym back, search box empty, Show set to all

start: A gym started today shows as new and not checked

user_sees: The gym row says 'New, not checked yet' under its code
Tile 'Need a look' counts it
must_not: The new gym missing from the list

steps.action: Open the gym and tap 'Mark as checked', then go back with ‹ All gyms
user_sees: The row now shows the active status
'Need a look' one lower
must_not: The old status still shown after the page reloads

start: All gyms page; a gym owner has not opened support access

user_sees: Gym name, code, member and check-in counts, takings this month, owner name and owner mobile
must_not: Any member name, member mobile or receipt shown
The list readable without the HQ sign-in

user_sees: The file has gym-level facts only; the Log gets one line first
must_not: A download that leaves no Log line
